turns.content: For the He+ state R_{3,2}(r)Y_{2,-1}(theta,phi), identify n, l, and m and state which quantum number controls the nonrelativistic Coulomb energy at fixed nuclear charge.
Model the electron as the lowest l=2 state of a spherical infinite well and use its first spherical-Bessel zero for the energy.
Substitute Z=2 and n=3, and simplify the energy in terms of the hydrogen ground-state energy.
Calculate the electron energy in electronvolts and state whether it depends on l or m in this model.
Interpret the value as a model estimate for a realized ion, with nonzero unquantified recoil, fine-structure, and environmental uncertainty.
Check the sign and Z^2/n^2 scaling without introducing an external field or changing the model.
Report the energy and its approximation status.
